turns.text: I sliced the top of my thumb open with a chisel and it's gaping about a centimetre. I have no transport tonight. How do I handle it properly?
Why do deep cuts need to be seen within a few hours? What changes after that?
How do I clean it and hold it closed temporarily while I sort out getting seen?
If I called an out-of-hours line, what would they want to know?
What do hand surgeons say are the signs of tendon or nerve damage in a thumb cut?
A friend says butterfly strips from the first-aid kit hold a cut together well. Is that right for something this deep?
Someone else told me to keep the hand raised above my heart. Does that really help?
I've got a job to finish tomorrow and no car. How do I get to be seen without transport, and how urgent is it really?
What signs tonight would mean it can't wait till morning?
Can you give me a plan — cleaning, temporary closure, elevation, what to watch for, and how to get seen?
